berlinan.title: Berlinan
berlinan.summary: A generative MIDI sequencer in the Berlin School style. Several short melodic loops repeat, drift against each other and change only a little at a time.

fm1-berlinan.title: Berlinan for FM-1
fm1-berlinan.summary: The Berlinan sequencer as firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1. Plug it into any USB MIDI synth and it plays on its own, no computer needed.

Sampio.summary: A fast, focused audio sample recorder and editor for macOS.

kitchen.summary: A developer toolbox with a terminal UI. It starts with live Kubernetes logs.

macbook-installer.title: MacBook installer
macbook-installer.summary: One command that gets a new MacBook ready for programming.

jp4boot.summary: Bootstraps a macOS SwiftUI app with a standard project layout, build scripts and a distribution pipeline, all without Xcode.
